full_details: Gaunt is dying at Ely House. The speech is one run of some twenty lines. The sheet prints the opening and the turn, and not the middle. You walked it because October will want the breath. The memo kept the Burbages' word. At dinner she asked who was dying, and you said you are, in the second act. She took that as sense. You were not cast, and you did not go up to the Theatre. The third act stayed shut.
one_sentence: You walked one speech from first light until you could breathe it, and at dinner she said you had followed a hearse and then stood.
title: Walked the speech, and she said it followed a hearse
